title: Theo and the Witness
author: Hazel Iversen
blurb: Wendell Kavanagh, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
